function bSpec(id,vr){const S0=B[id],V=(S0.variants&&vr&&S0.variants[vr])||{};const S=Object.assign({},S0,{col:Object.assign({},S0.col)});for(const k in V){if(k in S0.col)S.col[k]=V[k];else S[k]=V[k]}return S}
/* paint a bird: pose stand · walk · peck · fly · glide · swim · dabble · sit (asleep, the head on the back) · takeoff; ph 0…1; the ground point at (0, 0);
   flying — the body at z = 0 (the world lifts it and draws the shadow) */
function bird(g,id,vr,pose,ph,h,o){const S=bSpec(id,vr),sc=S.scale||1,F=frame(h),C=S.col,near=F.near,TP=ph*TAU;o=o||{};
 const fly=pose==='fly'||pose==='glide'||pose==='takeoff',swim=pose==='swim'||pose==='dabble',sit=pose==='sit',L=S.len*sc,hh=S.r[0]*sc,hw=S.r[1]*sc;
 let zc=fly?0:swim?hh*.45:sit?hh*.95:S.zc*sc,tilt=fly?0:swim?.0:sit?.05:S.tilt;let bob=0,headD=0,headZ=0;
 if(pose==='walk'){bob=Math.abs(Math.sin(TP*2))*.006*sc;headD=(id==='pigeon'||id==='chicken'?Math.sin(TP*2)*.025:0)*sc}
 if(pose==='peck'){const k=Math.max(0,Math.sin(TP*2));tilt=S.tilt-.6*k;headZ=-k*(S.zc*sc+hh*.4);headD=k*.04*sc}
 if(pose==='dabble'){tilt=-1.2;zc=hh*.2}
 const bl=L*.55,ct=Math.cos(tilt),st=Math.sin(tilt),ax=[ct,0,st];   // the body's axis
 const bc=[-.02*sc,0,zc+bob];
 const prof=S.flat?[[-.5,.55,.75],[-.3,.85,.95],[0,1,1],[.3,.92,.92],[.5,.55,.6]]:[[-.5,.45,.55],[-.28,.85,.85],[0,1,1],[.28,.95,.9],[.5,.6,.6]];
 const BS=prof.map(p=>({c:add(bc,mul(ax,p[0]*bl)),d:ax,hh:hh*p[1],hw:hw*p[2]}));
 const front=add(bc,mul(ax,bl*.5)),rear=add(bc,mul(ax,-bl*.5));
 // the head: up and forward from the breast (tucked on the back when asleep)
 let hp;if(sit&&!fly)hp=add(bc,[.02*sc,0,hh*.95]);else hp=add(front,[S.neck[0]*sc+headD,0,S.neck[1]*sc+headZ+(swim?.02*sc:0)]);
 if(pose==='dabble')hp=add(front,[.03*sc,0,-hh*.6]);
 const hr=S.head*sc,look=(pose==='stand'?.35*Math.sin(TP):0)+(o.look||0),bd=nrm([Math.cos(look),Math.sin(look),pose==='peck'?-.6*Math.max(0,Math.sin(TP*2)):-.12]);
 // the tail
 const tUp=S.tailUp||0,tl=S.tail[0]*sc,tw=S.tail[1]*sc,spread=fly?1.5:1,tdir=nrm([-1,0,fly?0:swim?.35:(tUp?tUp:-.15)]);
 const tb=add(rear,[0,0,hh*.15]),tt=add(tb,mul(tdir,tl));
 const tailPts=[add(tb,[0,-tw*.45,0]),add(tt,[0,-tw*.5*spread,0]),add(tt,[-.01*sc,0,0]),add(tt,[0,tw*.5*spread,0]),add(tb,[0,tw*.45,0])];
 const parts=[],Dbody=F.D(bc);
 // shadow (standing / swimming)
 if(!fly)groundEll(g,F,0,0,L*.42,hw*1.25+.02*sc,'#000000',swim?.12:.2);
 if(swim){const A=[F.c*L*.5*M,F.s*L*.5*M*KY],Bv=[-F.s*hw*1.35*M,F.c*hw*1.35*M*KY];g.beginPath();g.save();g.transform(A[0],A[1],Bv[0],Bv[1],0,0);g.arc(0,0,1,0,TAU);g.restore();g.strokeStyle='#e8f6ff';g.globalAlpha=.5;g.lineWidth=Math.max(.3,.012*M);g.stroke();g.globalAlpha=1}
 // legs
 if(!fly&&!swim&&!sit){for(const s of[-1,1]){const hip=add(bc,[0,s*hw*.4,-hh*.6]);let fu=0,fz=0;if(pose==='walk'){const q=((ph+(s>0?.5:0))%1);fu=(q<.5?(.5-q*2):(-.5+(q-.5)*2))*.06*sc;fz=q>=.5?Math.sin((q-.5)*2*Math.PI)*.015*sc:0}
   const ft=[hip[0]+fu,hip[1],fz];parts.push({k:F.D(hip)+(s===near?3:-3),f:()=>{line(g,F,[hip,ft],Math.max(.008,S.legs*.12)*sc,s===near?C.leg:sh(C.leg,.7));
    line(g,F,[ft,add(ft,[.03*sc,s*.006*sc,0])],.006*sc,s===near?C.leg:sh(C.leg,.7));line(g,F,[ft,add(ft,[.02*sc,s*.02*sc,0])],.005*sc,sh(C.leg,.8))}})}}
 // wings
 const wingRoot=(s)=>add(bc,[.02*sc,s*hw*.75,hh*.35]);
 if(fly){const span=S.span*sc,ch=S.chord*sc;let lift,sweep,bend;
  if(pose==='glide'){lift=span*.06;sweep=0;bend=.15}else if(pose==='takeoff'){lift=span*.38*Math.sin(TP);sweep=-.05;bend=.3}else{lift=span*.3*Math.sin(TP);sweep=.04*Math.cos(TP)*span;bend=.25+.15*Math.cos(TP)}
  for(const s of[-1,1]){const R1=add(bc,[.07*sc+ch*.25,s*hw*.8,hh*.3]),R2=add(bc,[-ch*.6,s*hw*.8,hh*.2]),W=add(bc,[ch*.3+sweep,s*span*.3,hh*.3+lift*.45]),Tp=add(bc,[-ch*.5+sweep*1.5-bend*ch,s*span*.5,hh*.3+lift]),
    TM=add(bc,[-ch*.85+sweep,s*span*.28,hh*.25+lift*.4]);const key=F.D(W)+(s===near?.2:-.2);
   parts.push({k:key,f:()=>{const up=lift>=-span*.05,top=s===near||up;poly(g,F,[R1,W,Tp,TM,R2],up?(s===near?C.wing:sh(C.wing,.82)):C.under);
    poly(g,F,[lerp3(W,Tp,.5),Tp,lerp3(TM,Tp,.45),lerp3(TM,W,.3)],up?C.tip:sh(C.tip,1.6),up?1:.6);
    if(C.bar&&id==='mallard')poly(g,F,[lerp3(R2,TM,.35),lerp3(R2,TM,.75),lerp3(R1,W,.75),lerp3(R1,W,.4)],C.bar,.9);
    if(S.fingers){for(let k=0;k<4;k++){const a=lerp3(lerp3(W,TM,.15+k*.18),Tp,.75),b=add(a,[-(k-1.5)*.05*sc,s*.12*sc,lift*.05]);line(g,F,[a,b],.045*sc,C.tip)}poly(g,F,[lerp3(R1,W,.5),lerp3(W,Tp,.4),lerp3(TM,Tp,.4),lerp3(R2,TM,.5)],sh(C.wing,1.18),.5)}
    if(C.mirror)dot(g,F,lerp3(Tp,W,.08),.018*sc,C.mirror);
    if(id==='hoopoe'){for(let k=1;k<4;k++)line(g,F,[lerp3(R2,TM,k/4),lerp3(R1,Tp,k/4+.1)],.012*sc,C.bar,.9)}}})}}
 else if(!sit||id!=='mallard'){for(const s of[-1,1]){const r=wingRoot(s),tip=add(rear,[-(S.tail[0]*.55)*sc,s*hw*.35,hh*.45]),mid=lerp3(r,tip,.55),down=[0,0,-hh*.42];
   parts.push({k:Dbody+(s===near?.5:-.5),f:()=>{const col=s===near?C.wing:sh(C.wing,.85);poly(g,F,[r,add(mid,[0,s*hw*.15,hh*.08]),tip,add(mid,down),add(r,down)],col);
    if(id==='pigeon'){for(const t of[.4,.58])line(g,F,[add(lerp3(r,tip,t),[0,s*hw*.08,hh*.02]),add(lerp3(r,tip,t+.06),down)],.012*sc,C.bar)}
    else if(id==='hoopoe'){for(const t of[.3,.45,.6,.75])line(g,F,[add(lerp3(r,tip,t),[0,s*hw*.1,hh*.04]),add(lerp3(r,tip,t+.05),down)],.01*sc,C.bar)}
    else if(id==='mallard')poly(g,F,[lerp3(r,tip,.45),lerp3(r,tip,.62),add(lerp3(r,tip,.62),mul(down,.6)),add(lerp3(r,tip,.45),mul(down,.6))],C.bar);
    else if(id==='sparrow')line(g,F,[lerp3(r,tip,.3),lerp3(r,tip,.4)],.008*sc,C.bar);
    poly(g,F,[lerp3(r,tip,.7),tip,add(lerp3(r,tip,.8),down)],C.tip,.9)}})}}
 // the tail
 parts.push({k:F.D(tt)+(F.s<0?.15:-.15),f:()=>{poly(g,F,tailPts,C.tail);poly(g,F,[lerp3(tailPts[0],tailPts[1],.7),tailPts[1],tailPts[2],tailPts[3],lerp3(tailPts[4],tailPts[3],.7)],C.tailTip,.95);
  if(S.col.ring&&id==='mallard'){line(g,F,[add(tt,[.03*sc,0,.01*sc]),add(tt,[.05*sc,0,.04*sc])],.012*sc,'#1a1a1a')}
  if(S.rooster){for(let k=0;k<4;k++){const b0=add(tb,[0,(k-1.5)*.02*sc,.02*sc]);line(g,F,[b0,add(b0,[-.08*sc,(k-1.5)*.02*sc,.14*sc]),add(b0,[-.2*sc,(k-1.5)*.03*sc,.1*sc]),add(b0,[-.24*sc,(k-1.5)*.03*sc,.02*sc])],.016*sc,k%2?C.tail:C.tailTip)}}}});
 // the body
 parts.push({k:Dbody,f:()=>{tube(g,F,BS,sh(C.body,.62),{kw:1.06,kh:1.06});tube(g,F,BS,C.body);tube(g,F,BS,C.belly,{kw:.85,kh:.45,dn:-.55,a:.85});
  tube(g,F,BS,C.back,{kw:.7,kh:.5,dn:.45,a:.9});if(C.breast)tube(g,F,BS.slice(3),C.breast,{kw:.95,kh:.8,dn:-.1});
  if(C.mottle){for(let i=0;i<BS.length;i++)for(let k=0;k<6;k++){const a=k/5*Math.PI,q=BS[i];dot(g,F,add(q.c,[0,Math.cos(a)*q.hw*.8,Math.sin(a)*q.hh*.8]),.008*sc,C.mottle,.6)}}
  if(id==='pigeon'){tube(g,F,BS.slice(3),C.sheen,{kw:.8,kh:.6,dn:.3,a:.55})}}});
 // the neck + head + beak (+ crest, comb)
 const Dh=F.D(hp);
 parts.push({k:Dh+(Dh>Dbody?.4:-.4),f:()=>{if(!(sit&&!fly)){const nk=[lerp3(front,hp,.0),lerp3(front,hp,.5),hp];tube(g,F,nk.map((c,i)=>({c,d:nrm([hp[0]-front[0],0,hp[2]-front[2]]),hh:lerp(hh*.6,hr*.9,i/2),hw:lerp(hw*.55,hr*.9,i/2)})),C.head);
   if(C.sheen&&id==='mallard')tube(g,F,nk.slice(1).map(c=>({c,d:[0,0,1],hh:hr*.95,hw:hr*.95})),C.head);
   if(C.ring)line(g,F,[add(nk[1],[0,-hr*.9,-.005*sc]),add(nk[1],[0,hr*.9,-.005*sc])],.01*sc,C.ring);
   if(id==='pigeon')tube(g,F,nk.slice(0,2).map(c=>({c,d:[0,0,1],hh:hr*.95,hw:hr})),C.sheen2,{a:.45})}
  tube(g,F,[{c:add(hp,mul(bd,-hr*.5)),d:bd,hh:hr*.85,hw:hr*.8},{c:hp,d:bd,hh:hr,hw:hr*.92},{c:add(hp,mul(bd,hr*.5)),d:bd,hh:hr*.8,hw:hr*.75}],C.head);
  tube(g,F,[{c:add(hp,[0,0,hr*.3]),d:bd,hh:hr*.45,hw:hr*.5}],sh(C.head,1.25),{a:.5});
  if(C.sheen&&id==='mallard')tube(g,F,[{c:add(hp,[0,0,hr*.25]),d:bd,hh:hr*.5,hw:hr*.55}],C.sheen,{a:.6});
  // the beak
  if(!(sit&&!fly&&id!=='hoopoe')){const b0=add(hp,mul(bd,hr*.75)),bc2=S.beakCurve||0,tip=add(add(b0,mul(bd,S.beak*sc)),[0,0,-bc2*S.beak*sc]),mid=add(lerp3(b0,tip,.5),[0,0,-bc2*S.beak*sc*.3]),w=hr*(id==='mallard'?.42:.28);
   const bl2=nrm(crs([0,0,1],bd)),wv=mul(Math.hypot(...bl2)<1e-6?[0,1,0]:bl2,w);poly(g,F,[add(b0,wv),add(mid,mul(wv,.6)),tip,add(mid,mul(wv,-.6)),add(b0,mul(wv,-1))],C.beak);
   if(C.spot)dot(g,F,add(lerp3(b0,tip,.75),[0,0,-.006*sc]),.007*sc,C.spot);if(C.cere)dot(g,F,add(b0,[0,0,hr*.25]),hr*.22,C.cere)}
  dot(g,F,add(add(hp,mul(bd,hr*.25)),[0,near*hr*.72,hr*.25]),Math.max(.005,hr*.2),C.eye);
  if(C.bib)tube(g,F,[{c:add(hp,[.005*sc,0,-hr*.9]),d:[0,0,1],hh:hr*.5,hw:hr*.6}],C.bib);
  if(S.crest){const c0=add(hp,[-hr*.3,0,hr*.7]),open=pose==='stand'&&Math.sin(TP)>.6;if(open){for(let k=0;k<6;k++){const a=-.6+k*.32,tp=add(c0,[Math.cos(a+1.7)*.05*sc,0,Math.sin(a+1.7)*.05*sc]);line(g,F,[c0,tp],.012*sc,C.crest);dot(g,F,tp,.006*sc,C.crestTip)}}
   else{poly(g,F,[add(c0,[.01*sc,-.008*sc,0]),add(c0,[-.07*sc,0,-.005*sc]),add(c0,[.01*sc,.008*sc,0]),add(c0,[0,0,.012*sc])],C.crest);dot(g,F,add(c0,[-.065*sc,0,0]),.005*sc,C.crestTip)}}
  if(C.comb){const c0=add(hp,[0,0,hr*.85]);for(let k=0;k<(S.rooster?5:3);k++)dot(g,F,add(c0,[(.012-k*.012)*sc*(S.rooster?1.2:1),0,(S.rooster?.012:.006)*sc]),(S.rooster?.014:.01)*sc,C.comb);dot(g,F,add(hp,mul(bd,hr*.6)).map((v,i)=>i===2?v-hr*.9:v),(S.rooster?.013:.009)*sc,C.comb)}}});
 parts.sort((a,b)=>a.k-b.k);for(const p of parts)p.f()}

/* =============================== the turtles =============================== */
// shell: [u, z of the centre, half height, half width]; legs / flippers; head; walk (the tortoise) · crawl (the sea turtle on the sand) · swim · rest
const T={
 tortoise:{n:'צב יבשה מצוי',len:.3,shell:[[-.14,.055,.035,.085],[-.1,.075,.06,.11],[-.04,.085,.07,.12],[.03,.085,.07,.118],[.09,.075,.058,.105],[.135,.058,.035,.08]],
  legs:[[.08,.085,.03],[-.09,.085,.03]],head:[.14,.045,.075,.022],col:{shell:'#7a6438',dark:'#3a2e1a',light:'#b0985c',skin:'#8c7a52',rim:'#5a4826',eye:'#141414'},box:[.22,.28,.16,.2]},
 seaturtle:{n:'צב ים (חום)',len:.9,shell:[[-.42,.1,.04,.16],[-.3,.12,.075,.3],[-.1,.13,.085,.36],[.12,.13,.085,.35],[.3,.115,.07,.27],[.42,.1,.045,.16]],sea:true,
  flip:[.28,.28,.4,.11],rear:[-.36,.2,.16,.07],head:[.42,.08,.15,.07],col:{shell:'#6e5434',dark:'#3a2a18',light:'#a4844e',skin:'#8a7656',rim:'#4e3a22',eye:'#141414',scale:'#c8b890'},box:[.7,.8,.65,.35]}};
function turtle(g,id,vr,pose,ph,h,o){const S=T[id],F=frame(h),C=S.col,near=F.near,TP=ph*TAU,swim=pose==='swim',rest=pose==='rest';
 const low=swim?-.06:0,SS=S.shell.map(q=>({c:[q[0],0,q[1]+low],d:[1,0,0],hh:q[2],hw:q[3]}));
 groundEll(g,F,0,0,S.len*.55,(S.sea?.36:.12)*1.15,'#000000',swim?.1:.22);
 if(swim){const A=[F.c*S.len*.62*M,F.s*S.len*.62*M*KY],Bv=[-F.s*.5*M,F.c*.5*M*KY];g.beginPath();g.save();g.transform(A[0],A[1],Bv[0],Bv[1],0,0);g.arc(0,0,1,0,TAU);g.restore();g.strokeStyle='#e8f6ff';g.globalAlpha=.45;g.lineWidth=Math.max(.3,.015*M);g.stroke();g.globalAlpha=1}
 const parts=[],Dsh=F.D(SS[2].c);
 // the limbs
 if(S.sea){const [fu,fv,fl,fw]=S.flip,[ru,rv,rl,rw]=S.rear;for(const sd of[-1,1]){const st=pose==='crawl'?Math.sin(TP):swim?Math.sin(TP)*1.2:.25,
   root=[fu,sd*fv,.06+low],dir=[-.35-.55*st,sd*(.85-.25*Math.abs(st)),swim?.1*Math.cos(TP):-.08],d=nrm(dir),tip=add(root,mul(d,fl)),mid=add(lerp3(root,tip,.5),[.0,0,.0]),w=[-d[1]*fw*sd*.0,0,0];
   const P1=add(root,[.05,0,0]),P2=add(mid,[.04,sd*.0,0]),P3=tip,P4=add(mid,[-.06,0,0]),P5=add(root,[-.06,0,0]);
   parts.push({k:F.D(root)+(sd===near?1:-1),f:()=>{poly(g,F,[P1,P2,P3,P4,P5],sd===near?C.skin:sh(C.skin,.72));for(let k=1;k<4;k++)dot(g,F,lerp3(root,tip,k/4),.012,C.scale||sh(C.skin,1.3),.6)}});
   const rr=[ru,sd*rv,.05+low],rt=add(rr,[-rl*.8,sd*rl*.5,-.03]);parts.push({k:F.D(rr)+(sd===near?1:-1),f:()=>poly(g,F,[add(rr,[.04,0,0]),rt,add(rr,[-.05,sd*.02,0])],sd===near?C.skin:sh(C.skin,.72))})}}
 else{for(const [lu,lv,lw] of S.legs)for(const sd of[-1,1]){const front=lu>0,key=(front?0:.5)+(sd>0?.5:0),q=((ph+key)%1+1)%1,step=pose==='walk'?(q<.6?(.5-q/.6)*.05:(-.5+(q-.6)/.4)*.05):0,lift=pose==='walk'&&q>=.6?Math.sin((q-.6)/.4*Math.PI)*.015:0;
   const hip=[lu,sd*lv*.85,.04],ft=[lu+step+(front?.02:-.02),sd*(lv+.02),lift],pts=rest?[hip,add(hip,[front?.02:-.02,sd*.02,-.03])]:[hip,lerp3(hip,ft,.5),ft];
   parts.push({k:F.D(hip)+(sd===near?1:-1),f:()=>{limb(g,F,pts,pts.map(()=>lw),sd===near?C.skin:sh(C.skin,.72));if(!rest){const f=F.P(ft);g.fillStyle=C.dark;g.beginPath();g.ellipse(f[0],f[1],Math.max(.3,lw*M*.55),Math.max(.25,lw*M*.35),0,0,TAU);g.fill()}}})}}
 // the head and the neck
 {const [hu,hz,hl2,hr]=S.head,out=rest&&!S.sea?.35:1,look=pose==='walk'||pose==='crawl'?.18*Math.sin(TP*.5):.3*Math.sin(TP),dirH=[Math.cos(look),Math.sin(look),swim?.05:-.12],b0=[hu-.03,0,hz+low],b1=add(b0,mul(dirH,hl2*out));
  const HS=[{c:b0,d:dirH,hh:hr*.8,hw:hr*.8},{c:lerp3(b0,b1,.6),d:dirH,hh:hr*.95,hw:hr*.9},{c:b1,d:dirH,hh:hr*.8,hw:hr*.75}];
  parts.push({k:F.D(b1)+(F.D(b1)>Dsh?.5:-.5),f:()=>{tube(g,F,HS,sh(C.skin,.7),{kw:1.08,kh:1.08});tube(g,F,HS,C.skin);tube(g,F,HS.slice(1),sh(C.skin,1.2),{kw:.5,kh:.4,dn:.5,a:.6});
   dot(g,F,add(HS[2].c,[0,near*hr*.6,hr*.35]),hr*.18,C.eye);if(S.sea){for(let k=0;k<3;k++)dot(g,F,add(HS[1].c,[(k-1)*hr*.4,0,hr*.85]),hr*.18,C.scale,.7)}}})}
 // the tail (the tortoise)
 if(!S.sea)parts.push({k:F.D(SS[0].c)-.1,f:()=>line(g,F,[[-.13,0,.04],[-.17,0,.025]],.012,C.skin)});
 // the shell, and its scutes
 parts.push({k:Dsh,f:()=>{tube(g,F,SS,C.rim,{kw:1.05,kh:1.06,dn:-.02});tube(g,F,SS,C.shell);tube(g,F,SS,C.light,{kw:.6,kh:.45,dn:.5,a:.55});
  const top=(q,a,f)=>add(q.c,[0,Math.cos(a)*q.hw*(f||1),Math.sin(a)*q.hh*(f||1)]),n=SS.length;
  const lw=S.sea?.012:.006;line(g,F,SS.map(q=>top(q,Math.PI/2,.99)),lw,C.dark,.8);for(const a of[Math.PI*.3,Math.PI*.7])line(g,F,SS.slice(1,-1).map(q=>top(q,a,.98)),lw,C.dark,.7);
  for(let i=1;i<n-1;i++){const P=[];for(let k=0;k<=6;k++)P.push(top(SS[i],Math.PI*.12+k*Math.PI*.76/6,.99));line(g,F,P,lw*.9,C.dark,.6)}
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++)for(const a of[Math.PI*.05,Math.PI*.95])dot(g,F,top(SS[i],a,1),lw*1.2,C.dark,.5)}});
 parts.sort((a,b)=>a.k-b.k);for(const p of parts)p.f()}

/* =============================== the sprites (the cache) =============================== */
const ST={main:()=>true,on:true,budgetMB:16,pumpMs:4,made:0,madeMs:0,hits:0,miss:0,direct:0,evict:0,bytes:0,frameMs:0,frameAt:-1,err:'',lastErr:''};
const CACHE=new Map();
const DIRS={cow:24,sheep:24,goat:24,horse:24,ibex:24,gazelle:24,cat:16,dog:32,tortoise:16,seaturtle:16},BDIRS=16;
const FR={stand:8,walk:12,trot:8,run:8,graze:8,drink:6,lie:6,bstand:4,bwalk:8,peck:8,fly:8,glide:2,swim:4,dabble:4,sit:4,takeoff:6};
function isBird(id){return!!B[id]}
function isTurtle(id){return!!T[id]}
function nFrames(id,pose){if(isTurtle(id))return pose==='rest'?4:8;return isBird(id)?(FR[pose==='stand'||pose==='walk'?'b'+pose:pose]||4):(FR[pose]||8)}
function resOf(g){try{const T=g.getTransform();const k=Math.hypot(T.a,T.b)||1;const L=[1,1.5,2,3,4.5,6];for(const r of L)if(k<=r*1.08)return r;return 6}catch(e){return 1}}
// the box of a sprite (px from the ground point, at res 1): the corners of the animal's box turned to the heading
function boxOf(id,vr,pose,h){const S=isTurtle(id)?T[id]:isBird(id)?bSpec(id,vr):qSpec(id,vr),sc=S.scale||1,b=S.box,fly=pose==='fly'||pose==='glide'||pose==='takeoff',F=frame(h);
 const Rb=(fly?b[0]+.3:b[0])*sc,Rf=b[1]*sc,W=(fly?Math.max(b[2],(S.span||0)*.55):b[2])*sc,z0=fly?-(S.span||1)*.45*sc:-.05,z1=(fly?(S.span||1)*.45:b[3])*sc;let x0=1e9,y0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y1=-1e9;
 for(const u of[-Rb,Rf])for(const v of[-W,W])for(const z of[z0,z1]){const p=F.P([u,v,z]);x0=Math.min(x0,p[0]);x1=Math.max(x1,p[0]);y0=Math.min(y0,p[1]);y1=Math.max(y1,p[1])}
 return[Math.floor(x0-2),Math.floor(y0-2),Math.ceil(x1+2),Math.ceil(y1+2)]}
